blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyer Romulo Macalintal, an advocate for the rights of senior citizens and persons with disabilities (PWDs), on Tuesday urged authorities to pursue an investigation into the “Machong Chismisan” podcast hosts to the fullest extent of the law over their insensitive remarks about Kris Aquino’s eldest son, Josh, who is on the autism spectrum. “I strongly join the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) in pursuing this condemnable offense committed by the hosts of the Machong Chismisan podcast against Josh Aquino’s disability,” he said in a statement.
